# Hyperdrive — Phase 1: wraps Neon/Postgres for low-latency DB access
# After deploying: wrangler hyperdrive create paperclip-hyperdrive --connection-string="<neon-url>"
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[[hyperdrive]]
binding = "HYPERDRIVE"
id = "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Queues — background fanout (cost rollups, activity log flush, plugin jobs)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[[queues.producers]]
binding = "PAPERCLIP_QUEUE"
queue = "paperclip-jobs"

[[queues.consumers]]
queue = "paperclip-jobs"
max_batch_size = 10
max_batch_timeout = 5
max_retries = 3
dead_letter_queue = "paperclip-jobs-dlq"
